title: K Empty Slots
description: Find the earliest day k empty slots exist between two bloomed flowers.
pseudocode:
1. Create days array where days[i] is bloom day of flower at i+1
2. Use sliding window of size k+2
3. Slide window and check if conditions met

steps.note: Initialize days array from bulbs=[1,3,2], k=1
Window starts at index 0 (left=0, right=2) for k=1
Check window [1, 3, 2]. days[1]=3 is > 1 and > 2. Condition met at day 2.
